note: Path fixture. notif-xpc-deadlock names the clamped jaw vs a limber bite.

paths.rule: main thread free — limber; notification post/close never blocks UI; jaw opens
paths.result: posting or clearing a macOS notification must never block the main thread

paths.rule: when the terminal-done chime posts, addNotificationRequest must not wait on a close-held XPC queue
paths.result: main thread blocked in addNotificationRequest while NotificationService.close holds the XPC path — lock-order deadlock

paths.rule: app must stay responsive after a terminal command completes
paths.result: window cannot be moved or force-redrawn; force quit is the only way out
